_template: NOT QUEUED. Copy to round_cards/queue/<id>.json after: (1) the round folder runs/pulse/<loop>/<round>/ exists with prereg.json written by `loop_round.py prereg` (script + split hashes, prediction, rescore recipe) BEFORE any scoring; (2) the round script (module with score(ctx)) is final and has had a --dev run on select; (3) the id/task/prediction/command fields below are filled. Replace every <angle bracket> value.
_runner_needs: run_round.py reads one float from result.key, so the round script's final results.json must expose the primary's confirm top-1 as a flat or dotted key (e.g. primary_confirm_top1)
run_round.py cannot check the keep rule (paired test, Holm, live checks); the round script must write keep_rule.decision into results.json and a person or the picker records ADOPT or DO NOT ADOPT
the live checks (publisher-section agreement, share error) need a fresh live trace run, which is not a card command; they stay a separate step before adoption
loop_permissions.json must allow MN-DS training for this re-ranker (L2751) and the card must stay CPU only and under 60 minutes
the card's baseline must be a result file of the previous adopted model, not a number typed in
question: What share of clean held-out MN-DS articles (confirm half, publishers never trained on) get the right top-level IPTC topic from <the round's primary model>?
one_change: <one named change to the primary option, as written in prereg.json>

prediction.why: <reason from the previous round's cause-to-action table row, no comparison words>

command: D=runs/pulse/topic_loop/<round>; PY=/workspace/models/embed-zs/.venv/bin/python; $PY loop_round.py check $D && $PY loop_round.py score $D --final && $PY loop_round.py rescore $D --part confirm

smoke.command: D=runs/pulse/topic_loop/<round>; PY=/workspace/models/embed-zs/.venv/bin/python; $PY loop_round.py --selftest && $PY loop_round.py check $D && $PY loop_round.py score $D --dev
